scope: Reconciliation of three accepted immutable inventories only; no donor re-audit, source import, runtime/data/service access or contract changes. All targets below are architecture intent requiring scoped acceptance.

evidence_hash_method: SHA256 canonical selected JSON value: Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False).encode(UTF-8); RFC6901 pointers resolve in raw-digest-pinned input. Raw digest includes final newline.

repository.target: P01/C14 scoped transactional repository and source catalog
repository.rule: Preserve original source IDs, Double/integer/text precision and independent raw/aggregate/derived kind; mark unknown provenance and gaps. Full retained history is disk-paged, not limited by dashboard/mirror windows.

ui.target: Shared React feature state and Effect complete operations (P02/L02/S03)
ui.rule: Preserve the referenced outcome, filters, reducers and current bounds as evidence; extend full retained-range paging with explicit coverage. Native maps/icons/Photos/report adapters require their own SDK and grant admission.

native.rule: Retain source-specific acquisition meaning, independent watch and queue/ack recovery; separately qualify permissions, signed host/channel, background execution, physical device and energy. No CLI flag grants OS permission.

compatibility.target: C15/P02 versioned browser-free compatibility renderer/reader fixtures
compatibility.rule: Retain exact referenced format, version, precision, ordering and limits only after golden and real consumer proof. Legacy files remain readable with explicit losses; they are not the complete archive.

import.target: P03/C17/L05/S04 complete archive and staged transactional import/Undo
import.rule: Read all available authorized state before lossy donor migrations; preserve IDs, associations, raw precision, annotations/settings and queue state, validate checksums and repeat/conflict/crash recovery. No automatic grant, endpoint or credential activation.

jobs.rule: One frozen source/detail/destination request, strict/partial coverage, occurrence math, bounded materialization, revision-aware merge/catch-up, accounting/cancel/recovery. Replace donor scheduler/transport ownership; inert settings preview and explicit destination enrollment.

service.target: Owner source-purpose/egress/support decision followed by separately authorized service integration
service.rule: Do not inherit CloudKit/relay/Worker/analytics/commerce/update channels, accounts, secrets or armed webhooks. Preserve available permitted history separately from donor service adoption. Wake remains notification-only; Practice, website and provider broker remain independent.

excluded.target: Explicitly excluded initial browser/input acquisition; any later scope requires owner decision and new source contract
excluded.rule: Exclude browser page/domain/history/title, keys/text/pointer/scroll before observation AND persistence/import/egress. Browser application duration remains allowed. No private database/report sandbox escape or arbitrary SQL inherited.

qualification.rule: Keep every referenced gap and proposed/unrun case open. Planning reconciliation is not acquisition, export eligibility, import completeness, production support or family closure.
